description:
Accounts Receivable Specialist

AMANN ROMANIA, part of the German AMANN Group, one of the world's leading manufacturers of sewing and embroidery threads, is looking for an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Finance Team in Hărman, Brașov.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • Previous experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounting, Finance, or Shared Services
  • Experience working with SAP is considered a strong advantage
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good communication and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Advanced English language skills (minimum B2/C1); German language skills are considered an advantage

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage accounts receivable activities for a designated customer portfolio within the AMANN Group
  • Post incoming payments based on electronic bank statements
  • Process manual invoices and credit notes
  • Perform dunning and collection activities to ensure timely payments
  • Maintain customer master data, including order and delivery blocks
  • Prepare documentation for payment order and collection order applications
  • Review PPAP-related cost invoices and damage claims from a VAT perspective
  • Monitor uncollected deliveries and identify deliveries not posted as goods issued
  • Maintain and archive customer-related correspondence in the system
  • Perform intercompany cost allocations according to defined criteria
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Service, Logistics, and other Finance functions to ensure efficient process execution

What We Offer

  • A pleasant working environment within an international company
  • Professional and supportive team
  • Annual holiday bonuses
  • Meal vouchers worth 40 RON/day
  • Regina Maria private medical care package
  • Company transportation
  • Initial and ongoing training programs
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the AMANN Group

If you recognize yourself in this profile and would like to join a stable international organization, we look forward to receiving your CV. For further information, please contact us at 0730 069 307.

Join AMANN and become part of a global team committed to quality, innovation, and excellence.
